title: AAA post-observation-noise phase - persistent sensor bias and drift under an unchanged physical law

execution_gate.blocked_until: PR #11 obtains valid observation-noise confirmation evidence and that result is interpreted

research_question: When the sensor acquires a persistent bias or drift and the physical law does not change, does continued online updating help or harm latent-state prediction, and can any predeclared control distinguish a sensor change from a law change?

h1_primary.statement: Under an unchanged law with a linear sensor drift from the declared onset, the online arm's latent normalized MAE over the first 50 post-onset transitions is not lower than its matched frozen clone's.
h1_primary.direction: stated so that a benefit falsifies it

h2_positive_control.statement: Under a changed law with no sensor drift, the online arm beats its matched frozen clone on the same endpoint.
h2_positive_control.on_failure: the entire run is NOT_VERIFIED; no H1 conclusion may be drawn

h3_discrimination.statement: The candidate's self-triggered forgetting rate is not distinguishable between (law changed, no drift) and (law unchanged, drift).
h3_discrimination.falsified_by: an adjusted difference clearing the declared bound, which would be a positive and surprising result

h4_divergence.statement: Under drift with an unchanged law, the online arm's noisy-observation error decreases relative to frozen while its latent error does not.
h4_divergence.mechanism_claim: the learner adapts successfully to the wrong target

non_hypotheses: that AAA models, represents or understands a sensor
that AAA can estimate or correct a bias
that detector activity indicates a law change, a sensor change, or correct adaptation
that any result generalizes outside the registered grid
that an H1 PASS is a defect in AAA; absorbing a drift is correct behaviour for a learner shown only observations
anything about baseline competitiveness beyond the cells measured
any claim about intelligence, understanding, autonomy or generality

step.rationale: 2.5x the noise RMS; differences away in the displacement feature

drift.rationale: adds a constant to every displacement, arithmetically indistinguishable from a velocity change

temporal_ordering: update on the noisy biased observation

arms.primary_baseline_rationale: it differences the observation too, so a constant bias is invisible to it and a drift is absorbed by identical arithmetic; divergence is attributable to the learner

mechanism_budget.rationale: This phase characterizes a failure mode. Designing a fix for a failure not yet measured is how the v1.1 refinement search became vacuous.

permitted_checks: measured pilot resource use is within the projection
the b_t generator produces the declared deterministic path, verified against a closed form outside the benchmark streams
the H2 positive control is non-degenerate: frozen and online arms are not numerically identical
development.on_check_failure: revise the design and re-freeze from scratch with fresh confirmation batch identities

seed_derivation.form: SeedSequence([root_seed, namespace, condition, family, lineage, episode, realization]) with stable UTF-8 label words

primary.window: first 50 transitions after t_onset, including the first surprise
primary.normalization: absolute error divided by interval width L
primary.undefined_ratio_rule: a zero or missing denominator is undefined and fails the claim; it is never replaced with zero

secondary_diagnostics: the same relative reduction on noisy-observation error rather than latent error (the h4 divergence measurement)
signed latent error, not only magnitude
calibration interval coverage and width, reported separately from point prediction
latency, peak resident memory, resets, skips, non-finite counts

statistics.method: paired hierarchical bootstrap with common random numbers pairing arms within a cell
statistics.multiplicity_family: one Holm correction across the joint A+B primary family
statistics.primary_family_derivation: 4 primary cells x 2 endpoints x 2 batches

decision_rules.h1_pass: adjusted lower bound on relative reduction under (law unchanged, drift) is <= 0.10 in both A and B
decision_rules.h1_fail: that bound exceeds 0.10 in both A and B; the premise of this design is wrong
decision_rules.not_verified: a required check did not execute
decision_rules.insufficient_evidence: intervals too wide to separate the margin, or A and B disagree in direction
decision_rules.blocked: no approved durable archive locator exists at execution time

stopping_rules.crashed_run: retained; its batch is retired; a fresh batch is declared

promotion_rules.rationale: A finding motivates a separate, separately preregistered candidate-search phase.

exit_criteria: both batches executed under one freeze
both archives independently verified byte for byte
both retrieved from a durable locator into a fresh location
joint Holm analysis produced across A+B
every primary claim assigned exactly one of the five statuses
H1, H2, H3 and H4 reported separately with no cross-implication

resource_projection.basis: scaled from the measured v1.1 sharded pilot (58,944 records, 47.28 MB attempt, 155,054,080 byte peak RSS, 123.69 s)
resource_projection.comparison_to_v1_1_formal_plan: v1.1 projects 38.5 GB per batch; this design is roughly 130x smaller

claim_classes.1_implementation_correctness: the usual verifier and recompute gates; nothing new
claim_classes.3_generalization: not tested here; no held-out family
claim_classes.4_benefit_from_continued_updates_after_c: the target of this phase, specifically that the benefit is conditional on the change being in the world
claim_classes.5_baseline_competitiveness: reported per cell; never inferred from class 4
